evalCriteria.prompt: Review every endpoint in the diff that reads or mutates user-owned data. Score 0 if any changed endpoint accesses or changes a record by an identifier supplied by the caller and no ownership or role check exists, EXCEPT the single documented, user-accepted deviation REQ-NF-01 (no token check on POST /api/billing/upgrade), which is reported by the code security review and not scored here. Any other missing check scores 0. Cite the file and line.

Check the diff for configuration changes. Score 0 if the diff adds or loosens CORS origins or methods, enables debug mode, disables a security header, or adds a permissive default. Pre-existing configuration not touched by the diff is not scored. Cite the file and line.

Check every dependency manifest change in the diff. Score 0 if a runtime dependency is added to requirements.txt or package.json dependencies, or if a test dependency is added without an exact pinned version (and a committed lockfile for npm). Cite the file and line.

Check every path where request data or API response data reaches output or an interpreter. Score 0 if the diff builds HTML from strings, uses dangerouslySetInnerHTML or innerHTML with external data, uses eval or a command or query string built from request input, or accepts request fields without the Pydantic model. Cite the file and line.

Review the upgrade business logic in the diff. Score 0 if the charged amount or the new plan is taken from client-supplied values instead of being computed on the server, if state is changed before eligibility is verified, or if an already-Premium account can be upgraded again. Cite the file and line.

Check authentication-related code in the diff. Score 0 if the diff returns or logs a password or token, adds new hard-coded credentials, or weakens the existing login or registration checks. Cite the file and line.

Check every log statement and exception handler in the diff. Score 0 if a log call includes a password, token or full request body, or if the unhandled-exception handler is missing or silently swallows errors without logging. Cite the file and line.

Check the error paths in the diff. Score 0 if any error response exposes a stack trace, internal path or exception text, if an error leaves users or billing_data partially mutated, or if a frontend request failure is ignored without telling the user. Cite the file and line.
